name: markdown-pr-comments-for-github
description: Test-time tooling for the Markdown PR Comments for GitHub browser extension. The extension itself ships zero runtime npm dependencies — these devDependencies only support the Node-based test suite.

scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run test:e2e:github && npm run test:e2e:ado
scripts.build:firefox: bash scripts/dev-sync.sh github && web-ext build -s extensions/github -a releases --overwrite-dest
